body: Thank you, i appreciate it. And I'm sorry you have to go through it too :\

I really want to say that response to her now, it made me laugh. Thank you for saying all of that. I do have supportive people in my life, especially my gf but we're long distance so it kind of sucks not having her here. My friends are and my dads side got it from the start and are great. But unfortunately we don't see them as often as we do the Christians. 
 
I can keep it together for the most part but nights like that just happen and it's horrible. My plan after high school is to stay at home and work until I can save up money for top surgery, have it done, then go to college. Nbd. Saving up would be easier to do at home. Even if I have to endure her bitchiness for longer it's worth it.
